video_title: LaVar Ball Finally Gets All 3 Sons Together Again | Lonzo, Melo & Gelo - The LaVar Ball Show - Ep. 1

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball asks his sons about playing on the same NBA team
quotes.excerpt: How you think y'all would do all on the same team as grown men?

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: How you think y'all would do all on the same team as grown men?

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Obviously, I think we would be fine. It would be a good team, but I think that ship sailed.

text_blocks.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
text_blocks.text: It's like a dream team in my head if I played with my brothers.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball discusses the Knicks' roster and Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I was happy for Jalen Brunson for sure. I'm glad New York got it done.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: What you think about the Knicks winning? They had a good squad.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: I was happy for Jalen Brunson for sure. I'm glad New York got it done. I didn't know that took them that long. They haven't won in like 50 something years.

text_blocks.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
text_blocks.text: They got there though, but they didn't win.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball ranks the best Knicks point guards
quotes.excerpt: Probably Jalen Brunson for sure. Second Patrick Ewing. I didn't know that.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Who would you think is the best Knick ever?

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Probably Jalen Brunson for sure. Second Patrick Ewing. Third, I don't know.

text_blocks.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Patrick Ewing? I didn't know that.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball ranks the top five NBA point guards
quotes.excerpt: I'm going with Magic Johnson. Okay. I got Kyrie in there. Kyrie? Okay. Wow. I got Steph, Curry in there.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Top five guards in the NBA ever.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Magic. Okay. Steph. Is this my top five though?

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Your top five. D-Wade. Okay. Penny. Hardaway. Yes. And Isaiah Thomas.

text_blocks.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I'm going with Magic Johnson. Okay. I got Kyrie in there. Kyrie? Okay. Wow. I got Steph, Curry in there. That's three. I got Melo in there for real. And then, that's four. Who else is last? D-Rose.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball discusses the Knicks' championship-winning point guards
quotes.excerpt: When they won the first time, the point guard, who was Shaun Livingston? I know Shaun Livingston.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Who else played the point guard for the Knicks? Who was in the Knicks? So you had the starters, Brunson, Anunoby, Jose Alvarado was their backup, J-Hart, and Towns.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: When they won the first time, the point guard, who was Shaun Livingston? I know Shaun Livingston.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball argues that leadership is necessary to win championships
quotes.excerpt: If you don't bring leadership to the game, how you going to do anything? You got to bring leadership first.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: If you don't bring leadership to the game, how you going to do anything? You got to bring leadership first.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: I think people lead in their own way. I wouldn't say that they're bad leaders, but Jaylen Brunson is the only one that got it done out of all three of them.
